record.people: Jaime Valencia Valencia (General Manager of the Banco Central de Bolivia 1996-2006 and again from 16 January 2020; Manager of International Operations 1994-1996)
record.move: from senior posts at Banco de la Unión S.A., Banco de Cochabamba S.A. and Compañía Boliviana de Seguros S.A. to General Manager of the Banco Central de Bolivia
record.summary: The Banco Central de Bolivia's own CV for its General Manager states that he held the post from 1996 to 2006 and again from 16 January 2020, and was the bank's Manager of International Operations from 1994 to 1996, and that he held important positions at Banco de la Union S.A., Banco de Cochabamba S.A. and Compania Boliviana de Seguros S.A. The CV gives no job titles and no dates for those three firms, and no source opened this round states the ownership of any of them, so the move is filed uncounted pending an ownership check. The regulator ASFI's own history of financial supervision, which would settle how Banco de Cochabamba was owned, returned a client error and needs a hand check; a Los Tiempos anniversary article on the insurer's successor company names no shareholders.
